user_story: As a user, I want task creation to fail when the title is empty so that all tasks have a meaningful name.

positive.title: Create a task with a valid title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page.
Enter a valid title for the task.
positive.expected_result: The task is successfully created with the given title.

negative.title: Attempt to create a task with an empty title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the title cannot be empty.

edge.title: Attempt to create a task with a title consisting only of spaces
steps: Navigate to the task creation page.
Enter spaces in the title field.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the title cannot be empty.
